mapper.insert: insert into elderly_info(name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_id,nurse_id,self_care_status,nurse_level,check_in_time,home_address) values (#{name}, #{idNumber}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{familyContactInfo}, #{bedId},#{nurseId},#{selfCareStatus},#{nurseLevel},now(),#{homeAddress})
mapper.select: select elderly_info.elderly_id, name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_number, floor_number, room_number from elderly_info, bed_info, bed_elderly_association where elderly_info.bed_id = bed_info.bed_id

select elderly_info.elderly_id, name, elderly_info.bed_id, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_number, floor_number, room_number from elderly_info, bed_info where elderly_info.bed_id = bed_info.bed_id and room_number=#{roomNumber} and bed_number=#{bedNumber} and floor_number=#{floorNumber}
select elderly_id, name from elderly_info where id_number=#{idNumber}

select elderly_info.elderly_id, name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_number, floor_number, room_number, home_address, medical_history, allergy_history from elderly_info, bed_info where elderly_info.bed_id = bed_info.bed_id and elderly_info.elderly_id=#{id}

SELECT e.elderly_id AS elderlyId, e.name AS elderlyName, e.age, e.gender, e.contact_info AS contactInfo, e.medical_history AS medicalHistory, e.nurse_id AS nurseId, n.name AS nurseName, e.nurse_level AS nurseLevel, e.check_in_time AS checkInTime, e.check_out_time AS checkOutTime, e.physical_condition AS physicalCondition FROM elderly_info e LEFT JOIN nurse_info n ON e.nurse_id = n.nurse_id;

SELECT e.elderly_id AS elderlyId, e.name AS elderlyName, e.age, e.gender, e.contact_info AS contactInfo, e.medical_history AS medicalHistory, e.nurse_id AS nurseId, NULL AS nurseName, NULL AS nurseLevel, e.check_in_time AS checkInTime, e.check_out_time AS checkOutTime, e.physical_condition AS physicalCondition FROM elderly_info e LEFT JOIN nurse_info n ON e.nurse_id = n.nurse_id WHERE e.nurse_id IS NULL
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderlyName}, '%')
